final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ordersmark AS ref, AVG(remaincount) AS a FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ref, s1.a, s1.a - s2.m AS d1 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.a > s2.m), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.ref, s3.a, s3.d1, s3.a - s4.m AS d2 FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.a > s4.m) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_group_avg, AVG(d1) AS avg_step3_diff, AVG(d2) AS avg_step5_diff FROM s5
